4279-7316-7452--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-7316-7452--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2023-4068-4289-4770.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2023-4068-4289-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

997-3263-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
997-3263-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 3.
997-3263-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

997-1981-2415-8175.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Edgar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

2060-3755-4687.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least four counters on it.
2060-3755-4687.description:
Activate Elven Chorus by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Crystalline Crawler, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1870-3488-4873-5087.easyPrerequisites: Darksteel Reactor and Eternity Vessel have at least twenty charge counters combined.
1870-3488-4873-5087.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
1870-3488-4873-5087.description:
Use Katsumasa to make Eternity Vessel a creature.
Cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

851-4365-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Adrix and Nev and Mondrak.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
851-4365-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

45-579-1978-5793.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding four mana due to Mana Reflection.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Khalni Gem which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

862-3652-4973-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-3652-4973-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

3175-4775-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

1978-2364-7280.description:
Animate Mana Vault using Donatello.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mana Vault.
Repeat from step 2.

4659-5004-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Cathodion with haste.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Cathodion token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Cathodion token dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2921-3991-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-2907-5226.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2907-5226.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

5256-7083-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Baloth Prime trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Baloth Prime trigger, untapping it and creating a tapped 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

104-261-2034-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-261-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

874-1170-1329-2905.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-2905.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Delif's Cone.
Cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Pestermite.
When Pestermite enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

413-3234-3293-5226.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
413-3234-3293-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When World Shaper enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Repeat
413-3234-3293-5226.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2034-2558-3490-6701-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-2558-3490-6701-6798.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

292-1495-4565.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-4565.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

813-957-4598.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, taking two extra turns.
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch and Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each other turn.
813-957-4598.notes: If desired, you can do steps 2 and 3 during the first extra turn instead to spread out the mana costs.

2558-4742-4779-5687.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Nahiri's Resolve, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

1652-5626-5645.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
1652-5626-5645.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1636-2438-2857.notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2438-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Carrion Feeder.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing itself.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning Carrion Feeder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Carrion Feeder enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
1636-2438-2857.notes: You may target another nontoken creature you control instead to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Carrion Feeder.

117-185-957-2501-3098.manaNeeded: {8}{U}{U}, plus at most {3}{U} every third extra turn, and {8}{U}{U} every fourth extra turn
117-185-957-2501-3098.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with power two or greater.
You have not cast an instant or sorcery this turn.
117-185-957-2501-3098.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U} and sacrificing a creature with power two or greater, targeting yourself.
Time Stretch's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Time Stretch trigger, copying it, targeting yourself.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Time Stretchs, causing you to take four extra turns after this one.
Move to your third extra turn.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing a creature with power 2 or greater, targeting Mystic Retrieval.
Call to Mind's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Call to Mind trigger, copying it, targeting Time Stretch.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Call to Minds, returning Time Stretch and Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your fourth extra turn.
Repeat step 1 through 6 one additional time.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U} and sacrificing a Drake, targeting Call to Mind.
Mystic Retrieval's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Retrieval trigger, copying it, targeting Time Stretch.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Mystic Retrievals, returning Time Stretch and Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your fourth extra turn.
Repeat.

1471-2452-5113-5220.description:
Cast Mindleech Ghoul either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
When Mindleech Ghoul enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Mindleech Ghoul dies, Mortuary triggers, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

565-2450-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
565-2450-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Great Whale.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
The Great Whale token enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you can target any permanents you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

262-719-991.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Benthicore.
"Merfolk" chosen with Xenograft.
Benthicore does not have summoning sickness.
262-719-991.description:
Activate Benthicore by tapping it, creating five 1/1 Elemental tokens with haste that are also Merfolks due to Xenograft.
Activate Benthicore by tapping two Elemental tokens, untapping Benthicore.
Repeat.

1905-4283-4338-5295.notablePrerequisites: An additional creature on the battlefield.
1905-4283-4338-5295.description:
Activate Whisper, Blood Liturgist, sacrificing itself and an additional creature to return Volrath's Shapeshifter from the graveyard to the battlefield.
Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a zombie token.
Volrath's Shapeshifter enters the battlefield as a copy of Whisper, Blood Liturgist.
Activate Volrath's Shapeshifter, sacrificing itself and a zombie token to return Whisper, Blood Liturgist to the battlefield.
Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a zombie token.

4217-5067.easyPrerequisites: There is at least one nonland permanent on the battlefield.
4217-5067.description:
Cast Release to the Wind by paying {2}{U}
Holding priority, cast Lutri either from your hand or from the command zone by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Release to the Wind, targeting Lutri.
Resolve the Release to the Wind copy, exiling Lutri
Cast Lutri from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
